purpose: Teach: 譴/發/ココログ/茲/兇/廚/李/眞

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究室の倫理違反は譴責対象だと心得ろ
lines.en: Ren — ethical violations in the lab are grounds for reprimand. Understand that.
lines.style: Measured, direct. The weight of institutional authority beneath calm surface. No raising of voice; the firmness is in the precision of each word. A statement, not a threat.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。旧字体「發」が登場する古文献の解読を続けます
lines.en: Yes. I'll continue decoding the old documents where the classical character 發 appears.
lines.style: Quiet confirmation. Slight nervousness in the uptake — not from fear but from the weight of the correction landing. Careful enunciation of the task ahead. Respectful, steady.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究者がココログで情報発信する事例を読め
lines.en: Ren — read the case studies of researchers publishing through Cocolog.
lines.style: Brisk, instructional. The tone of someone moving past a difficult moment and back to work. No warmth, no coldness — efficient direction. Brief eye contact that dismisses without rudeness.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会発表で「茲に発表致します」と冒頭をしっかり
lines.en: Yes. I'll review how to open a conference presentation properly — with a clear statement like 'I present this here today.'
lines.style: Earnest but slightly stilted — the formality of the language sitting a little heavily on him. He's taking the instruction seriously enough to mirror its register. Measured pace.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、戦時下の兇器規制の文献を読め
lines.en: Ren — read the literature on weapon regulation during wartime.
lines.style: Same brisk, directive tone as before. A senior walking through a checklist of intellectual groundwork. No elaboration, no second-guessing. Authority that doesn't need to announce itself.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。古い料亭の廚房、つまり厨房文化の論文を読みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll read the papers on classical kitchen culture — the history of the 厨房 in old restaurants.
lines.style: Polite acceptance without fully understanding the leap in topic. A student learning not to question the method. Slight pause before naming the term, as if checking himself for accuracy.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、共同研究の李教授に丁寧に挨拶しろ
lines.en: Ren — extend a proper greeting to Professor Li on the joint research project.
lines.style: Returning to directive mode. Warm note underlying the instruction — this is guidance about something interpersonal, not purely technical. Still authoritative, but the undertone suggests he cares about how Ren presents himself.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。旧仮名遣いの眞、つまり真の文字を研究します
lines.en: Yes. I'll research the distinction between the old kana spelling of 眞 and the modern 真.
lines.style: Final affirmation with focus restored. The nervousness has settled into concentration. Clear delivery, the kind of precision that shows he's taking this seriously. Slightly formal closing cadence.
